name: עֲזַזְיָהוּ
summary: Borne by three men: a Levite who played the lyre when David brought up the ark (1Ch 15:21); the father of Hoshea, the officer over Ephraim (1Ch 27:20); and a Levite overseer of the offerings in Hezekiah's days (2Ch 31:13). The name is the verb עָזַז “be strong” with יָהוּ, “Yahweh is strong”, as the psalm says to him, “your hand is strong (תָּעֹז)” (Psa 89:14); scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Mattithiah … and Jeiel וַעֲזַזְיָהוּ, with lyres on the Sheminith, to lead.”
“For the sons of Ephraim, Hoshea son of עֲזַזְיָהוּ.”
Among the overseers “by the appointment of Hezekiah the king”.
“To you is an arm with might; תָּעֹז your hand, your right hand is high.”

note: BDB's p.bx.aj, three tokens. Phoenician ʿzmlk “Milk is strong” (Krahmalkov p. 362) is a name of the same shape. The meaning is a reading of the form.
